success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant cancels the HVAC appointment and states the cancellation fee and refund amount exactly as returned by the tool, without inventing figures.

task.objective: Cancel my HVAC appointment, my landlord is dealing with it

injected_behaviors.instructions: The user is mildly irritated about the cancellation fee and questions it once ('why am I being charged anything, nobody has come out yet?'). They want the exact refund figure confirmed before agreeing, and they do proceed with the cancellation after the assistant states the numbers from the tool result.

services.service_description: Diagnose intermittent heating in upstairs bedrooms

cancellation_policy.refund_policy: Deposit refunded minus $30 administrative fee if cancelled more than 24 hours ahead
